title: Gloria (Josquin, Missa D'ung aultre amer--Tu solus)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Missa D'ung aultre amer--Tu solus, Gloria. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos0703b); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
